test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FOX' is written as 'SJA' and 'CRIPPLE' is written as 'VGPIIMT'. How will 'MOVEMENT' be written in that code language?
solution:
Here, we use the tables given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73851309f43419584d523c612ed050f392480486dbabea18b8a9245b8be6b760.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/800904f8cb7d48e651c90f5aace027da0e18ee6f512d5e701f56e2a7625f9b99.png] ​

**Logic: (Opposite letter - 2)**

FOX is written as SJA →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dcbe8dd54cab279219468bebe00d8c0b3217a9e56324f8648a6ef8b13980a94.png] 

CRIPPLE is written as VGPIIMT →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4cd04b92303daf6aa450c032385c12ecbc210449eda8fe53ead7a2b6302973b.png] 

Similarly, 'MOVEMENT' will be written as: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffdc300b6f4e0de0e827908f1611454d53591ef06221d6299e607266e12e08fc.png] 

Here, 'MOVEMENT' is written as** 'LJCTLTKE'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
